verdict.rationale: Kick documents period locking: once the accountant closes a period they lock it, and the lock stops the finalized books from being changed by anyone, including the owner. The docs add that reports for locked periods stay accurate and stable, and that only non-financial actions (viewing, attaching receipts, adding notes) remain allowed. Missing for 10: documentation of the explicit unlock/reopen workflow (who can reopen and whether it is logged), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
